name: Can I prevent future water heater leaks?

mainEntity.name: Can I prevent future water heater leaks?

acceptedAnswer.text: While not all leaks can be entirely prevented, regular maintenance significantly reduces the risk of water heater leaks. This includes flushing your water heater annually to remove sediment buildup, which can corrode the tank over time. Inspecting the unit periodically for signs of rust, corrosion, or small drips can also help catch potential issues early. Considering a water heater with a longer warranty or installing a leak detection system can provide additional peace of mind and protection against unexpected failures.
acceptedAnswer.description: Regular maintenance like annual flushing, periodic inspections for rust, and considering a leak detection system can help prevent future water heater leaks.
